filter_change: Keep the original nonidentity Boolean formula library. Fit the best formula by balanced accuracy using even-indexed complete before/after transition pairs; require balanced accuracy on odd-indexed pairs and pooled pairs to pass fixed thresholds. Minimum 40 states in each half. Ties prefer fewer sources then expression order. Memory update and core code are unchanged.
primary_success: Strictly lower readout false-positive rate than the stratified change-tree baseline using the SAME selected new filter at budget 8, and higher direct-effect BA than that baseline at budget 4. Report ties as ties. Also compare both with the original-filter methods on the same fresh records.
retention_guard: At budget 4, new-filter components must not reduce physical-effect BA by more than 0.01 versus original-filter components on the same records. Report true-root suppression and noisy readout identification separately.
selection: Choose the new filter on development noise10 records only: among settings with <=0.01 low-budget physical-BA loss versus the original filter, maximize low-budget direct BA minus primary-budget readout FPR. Tie break in grid order. If none passes, select the setting with smallest physical-BA loss and explicitly mark failed guard. Select relaxed-threshold baseline by the analogous development objective on its own stratified tree. Both choices are frozen before confirmation.
fairness: All learners share identical before/after records, observed context, announced rounds, full history, intervention budgets and candidate variable set. Both proposed components and strongest tree receive exactly the same selected validation-based suppression set. The independent relaxed-threshold baseline is tuned on development. No roles, true noise probability or gold mechanism labels enter the filter or learner; simulator truth is used only for evaluation and development selection.
scope: Finite observed-context component study. Fresh procedural families, same existing template and supplied diagnostic acquisition schedule. No autonomous change localization, hidden-context identification, MuJoCo or LLM claims. Exact copies remain an identification control.
statistics: Average rounds within each family. Paired intervals over 24 independent procedural families, not probes. Low-budget and high-noise scope results are retained; no condition selection after confirmation.
preservation: Leave original core, observation adapter, tuple-memory modules, prior experiment records, manuscript and response untouched. New filter is an isolated experimental implementation until tested.
